subject: Medford Citywide Cleanup and Keep Medford Beautiful
overview: Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn announced the citywide cleanup scheduled for May 2, 2026, and introduced the new Keep Medford Beautiful chapter and its associated volunteer programs.

items.title: Upcoming City Events
items.summary: The Mayor highlighted several events on the city calendar for the upcoming three months, including Pride, Juneteenth, and Haitian Flag Day.

items.title: Medford Citywide Cleanup
items.summary: The citywide cleanup is scheduled for Saturday, May 2nd, from 10:00 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. at 22 locations across the city.

items.title: Keep Medford Beautiful Initiatives
items.summary: The Mayor announced the formation of a Keep Medford Beautiful chapter and detailed programs including tree and drain adoption, as well as incentives for sharing cleanup progress photos.
